stem:
Complete the table below showing the number of apple trees and number of conifers for each value of n.

n=1: apple trees=1, conifers=8
n=2: apple trees=4, conifers=?
n=3: apple trees=?, conifers=?
n=4: apple trees=?, conifers=?
n=5: apple trees=?, conifers=?
correctAnswer: n=2: 4 trees, 16 conifers; n=3: 9 trees, 24 conifers; n=4: 16 trees, 32 conifers; n=5: 25 trees, 40 conifers

rubric.description: All values for number of apple trees correct (4, 9, 16, 25 for n=2,3,4,5)
All values for number of conifers correct (16, 24, 32, 40 for n=2,3,4,5)
